From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Melissa Park <melissa@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T16:15:00Z
Subject: SRG Q3 calibration — private manager handoff

Folks,

We need to complete the SRG quarterly calibration and a sensitive handoff of manager notes for two contributors who are moving teams. This thread is to align on process, redaction, and a short manager-only calibration before any HR-facing handover. Key asks: 

- Can each manager prepare redacted manager notes (remove PII, customer names, and verbatim sensitive feedback) using the attached template (manager_notes_template.xlsx)?
- Laura/Monica: please flag any notes that you believe *must* be reviewed in full by HR/legal (and mark the reason).
- Neha: please confirm the minimal evidence HR needs for the org-change packet (audit logs, note timestamps, and any escalation records).

Attachments: SRG_goal_handbook_v1.pdf (context), manager_notes_template.xlsx (template).

I propose a 30-min manager-only calibration on Monday 2027-09-20 at 10:30 PT to run through edge cases, then we’ll hand a redacted bundle to HR. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a private Drive folder with restricted access.

High level timeline:
- Mon 9/20: manager calibration call (private)
- Tue 9/21: managers upload redacted notes to restricted Drive
- Wed 9/22: HR confirms completeness and prepares org-change packet

Please reply with any blockers or if you need a different cadence.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber

jonas@redwood.com

Jonas — thanks for the plan. I can take the lead on the calibration call and will prepare one redacted note to share as an example. A couple of quick items:

- I’ll remove direct customer identifiers but keep the behavioral anchors (impact/examples) so context isn’t lost.
- For cases where we have legal-sensitive comments (customer legal/regulatory concerns), I’ll flag them and put them in a separate sealed folder for Neha/legal to review.

I attached the manager_notes_template.xlsx with a sample row. I’ll be offline briefly Friday afternoon but will be ready before Monday.

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of vendor-side notes that often come up when external recruiters/support are involved: 

- Please confirm whether any of the raw notes will be shared outside Redwood (e.g., with candidate or external partner). If so, we need explicit consent or an NDA clause.
- For redacted bundles, provide a short provenance log (who edited, timestamp) — that speeds background checks/offer discussions.
- If HR will be looking at verbatim feedback for compensation calibration, please let me know so I can advise on sensitive phrasing.

We do have an NDA on file with Redwood, but I recommend the sealed folder and a one-line provenance file. Happy to join the calibration for 10 minutes at the end if useful.

Thanks — quick clarifications from HR: 

1) Minimal evidence for the org-change packet: redacted manager notes (as discussed), timestamps of note creation, escalation logs (if any), and one-line manager justification for the role move.
2) Please DO NOT include candidate-facing PII in any uploaded bundle. If a note contains PII we’ll need the unredacted version in a sealed HR/legal-only folder and a separate redacted copy for the packet.
3) Send manager notes to the restricted Drive folder I’ll create (I’ll share access only to the five people on this thread + HR counsel).

I attached sensitive_handling_checklist.docx — use it as a quick checklist before upload.
